title: Text extracter unable to copy deg symbol (°)
author: Stagnantwater949

judgment.rationale: The text-only reproduction says punctuation and the degree symbol are changed after OCR, but the issue does not include the original image, font/rendering context, or the selected OCR language. Focused code review shows PowerToys mostly forwards OCR output directly to the clipboard, so the missing discriminator is the actual source pixels and OCR context, not generic logs.
evidence: The issue supplies the expected string and the observed pasted output, including the degree symbol becoming 0 and punctuation being dropped.
No screenshot or sample image of the source text is attached.
src/modules/PowerOCR/PowerOCR/Helpers/OcrExtensions.cs primarily joins OCR words with spacing logic and does not explicitly normalize ° into 0 or strip punctuation.
src/modules/PowerOCR/PowerOCR/OCROverlay.xaml.cs copies the recognized text to the clipboard with Clipboard.SetText(grabbedText).
judgment.recommended_action: Request the exact source image and OCR-language context so the maintainer can separate OCR-engine misrecognition from a PowerToys post-processing bug.

fix_assessment.rationale: A code fix may exist, but the current report does not distinguish between upstream OCR recognition errors and a PowerToys text post-processing bug because the original source image and OCR-language context are missing.

issue_context.summary: Text Extractor produces the wrong output for a sample string containing punctuation and the degree symbol, but the original source image and OCR context are missing.
known_information: The report includes an expected string and an observed pasted result.
The issue is labeled Product-Text Extractor and Needs-Team-Response with no assignee.
The author edited the issue after the automated triage request.
inferences: The wrong result could come from OCR recognition itself, from the chosen OCR language, or from how PowerToys recombines recognized words.
The current code does not show an obvious direct replacement that would always turn ° into 0, so source pixels matter.
issue_context.analysis: The next useful step is to ask for the source image/text sample and OCR-language context, not a generic bug report ZIP, because the core ambiguity is in recognition input rather than logging.
initial_investigation: Read the complete issue body, the automated triage comment, the author follow-up, labels, and timeline.
Inspected src/modules/PowerOCR/PowerOCR/Helpers/OcrExtensions.cs and OCROverlay.xaml.cs to see whether PowerToys explicitly rewrites punctuation or the degree symbol before copying text.
Found no linked duplicate or fix PR that already owns this exact symbol-recognition failure.

comment.body:
Thanks for spelling out both the expected text and the pasted wrong output. The remaining ambiguity is that Text Extractor works from rendered pixels, so the maintainer still needs the actual source image and OCR-language context before deciding whether this is OCR-engine misrecognition or a PowerToys post-processing bug.

**Needed**
1. Please upload the smallest shareable image, screenshot, or document snippet that contains the exact failing text.
2. Please say which OCR language was selected when the failure happened and whether changing to another OCR language changes the result.
3. If possible, please upload a side-by-side screenshot showing the original text and the pasted wrong output.

This will distinguish a recognition-input problem from a PowerToys text recombination bug.
